results.criterion: the recurring Meet generates a transcript or smart-note event and is discovered automatically
results.detail: Proven on a real meeting, 2026-09-01. The CDT internal kick-off (spaces/44KbrlezvqkB, code rtd-siqf-aup) was registered at 08:29 UTC and held that morning; transcript.v2.ended arrived 12:40:59 and conference.v2.ended 12:48:37, both attributed to the source through the subscription that produced them. Nobody told the platform the meeting had happened -- it was discovered.

deliveries.note: The full chain, proven end to end: Drive change -> Workspace Events -> Pub/Sub -> OIDC-signed push -> Cloudflare Access bypass -> receiver -> attributed receipt. The created event was published at 12:08 while push authentication was still misconfigured; Pub/Sub retried it and it arrived at 12:59 once the OIDC token and both IAM bindings were in place, which also demonstrates that a delivery is not lost while the path is being repaired. Meet added 2026-09-01: the kick-off was registered before it was held, which is the only order that works -- a subscription delivers nothing about a conference that ended before it existed. Drive totals by then were 43 receipts across All, BizDev and Delivery, most of them organic activity by colleagues rather than probes.
